mail-1.subject: Atlas launch checklist
mail-1.body:
Alice — the launch checklist is written up and ready for a second pair of eyes. Everything we agreed in the review is in there, including the release code and the rollback plan.

Doc: http://docs.google.com/documents/atlas-launch

Walk it top to bottom before Thursday and tick the boxes you own. Bob, you are on the CI section.

mail-2.subject: Re: Atlas launch checklist
mail-2.body:
Read it. Two notes: the rollback step needs the repo link spelled out — http://github.com/northstar/atlas — and I would rather we point people at the walkthrough than at the slides.

Everything else I can tick today.

mail-3.subject: Re: Atlas launch checklist
mail-3.body:
CI section is green apart from the Windows path test, which is the hash-ordering thing again. Tracking it in the repo, not a launch blocker.

Walkthrough for the doc: http://youtube.com/watch?v=atlas-walkthrough

mail-9.body:
Four works. Not a word, obviously.

For what it is worth: take the call, then decide. Nobody ever regretted knowing the number.

mail-10.subject: Carol Nakamura shared a folder with you: Atlas
mail-10.body:
Carol Nakamura (carol@northstar.example) shared the folder "Atlas" with you. Seven files, plus a shortcut to the launch doc.

mail-11.subject: Comment for a Verge story on Atlas?
mail-11.body:
Alice — following up on my DM. I am writing about how Northstar made Atlas replay byte for byte, and I would rather quote you than guess.

Anything on the record before we publish? http://theverge.com/2026/atlas-determinism
